svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The whole arc on one timeline
svg.desc: A timeline from 1796 to 2027 with the axis broken at 1960: dated events on a top rail from Senefelder's printing to High-NA EUV, one lane per exposure technology spanning its first to last tool model in the data set, and the seven history chapters as shaded spans beneath the year axis.
svg.text: THE WHOLE ARC ON ONE TIMELINE, 1796–2027
1955–60: resist on oxide, planar process and IC
1982–88: excimers, CA resists, first KrF stepper
Chapters as shaded spans; lane ends = first and last tool model in the data set.
